name: error_429_rate_limited
description: Quota exhausted. Every RateLimit-* header plus Retry-After is present on the 429 itself. 🪤 The figures in `detail` are PROSE and disagree with the plan's tier table — never parse them.

body.title: Rate limit exceeded
body.detail: Anonymous callers get 20 requests/minute and 2000/day. A free API key raises this to 120/minute and 50000/day.
